title: Aromatic Egyptian Navy Beans Tagine
description: A spicy, light Egyptian tagine that brings navy beans to life with warm spices and a touch of citrus.
instructions: Rinse the navy beans and soak them in 800ml water for 8 hours or overnight.
Drain the beans and add them to a large pot with fresh water, bring to a boil, then simmer for 45 minutes until tender.
Heat a tablespoon of olive oil in the pot and sauté the sliced onion, minced garlic, and carrot until the onion is translucent.
Stir in tomato paste, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, paprika, and a bay leaf, cooking for 2 minutes to toast the spices.
Add the cooked beans and vegetable broth, bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and let it simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Turn off the heat and stir in lemon juice and chopped cilantro, season with salt to taste.
Serve the tagine hot, optionally garnished with additional cilantro.
Enjoy this aromatic, low‑fat Egyptian staple as a satisfying lunch.
